title: MirageCommandEnvelope
description: The envelope wrapping every structured sandbox action (spec Appendix C). `params` is validated separately against the schema registered for `command_type`'s major schema_version. Model/AI output is NEVER a shell command — command_type is always one of a fixed, registered set (Appendix I; framework enforced here, concrete sandbox action types registered in Stage 4 / Step 9b).

command_type.description: Dot-namespaced command type from the fixed registered action set, e.g. 'sandbox.place_artifact'.

expected_state_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency check against sandbox_instances.state_version; a mismatch rejects the command.

params.description: command_type-specific parameters, validated against the registered params schema for (command_type, schema_version major).
